wording: [Skill Change – Aura of Command → Aura of the Emissary obtained!]
holder-quote: But that new aura flickered around her. Changed by her meeting with the [Innkeeper].
Rags wondered if her [Aura of the Emissary] was doing some of the translating or if her reading was off.
She dashed down a street despite the disorientating hostile magic on her.
effect-quote: Rags ignored the illusion spells assailing her senses and trusted to the auras of the people around her.

holder-quote: Rags looks back into the scrying mirror and draws on something.
effect-quote: her feelings, her ego, her presence, which normally floats freely around her, unconscious

holder-quote: Having [Aura of the Emissary] also helped.
Rags pulled it around her like a cloak and reached into her bag of holding for something.
effect-quote: Rags pulled it around her like a cloak

holder-quote: Rags appeared, this time with sword and crossbow aflame
effect-quote: The Chieftain’s instincts had to be overridden by his conscious mind.
